This page should NOT create page links from code blocks or inline code.

Inline code: `[[t020 - code blocks]]`

```txt
[[t020 - code blocks]]
some other text
```

A code block fenced with tildes:

~~~txt
[[t020 - code blocks]]
~~~

An indented code block:

    [[t020 - code blocks]]

A code block fenced with four backticks, so it can show a three-backtick fence:

````md
```
[[t020 - code blocks]]
```
````
